info.title: Benefits Platform Accounting API
info.description: The 'Accounting' web service is a component of the Benefits Platform.

get.description: Retrieve a list of debit cards belonging to a specific person by Person ID

parameters.name: person_id
parameters.description: The GUID generated by the Identity Management System for accessing information belonging to this specific person

parameters.name: include_inactive_cards
parameters.description: Whether or not inactive cards should be included in the result set, defaulted to false

parameters.name: X-Request-Id
parameters.description: Optional correlation ID associated with the request.

404.description: Debit Cards not found for Consumer

get.summary: Get Debit Card Setup For Employer
get.description: Retrieve a list of the Debit Card Setups for each Debit Card Provider in use by a specific Employer by Business ID

parameters.name: business_id
parameters.description: The Business ID for the Debit Card Settings for an Employer

parameters.name: X-Request-Id
parameters.description: Optional correlation ID associated with the request.

200.description: Successfully retrieved Debit Card Settings information.

404.description: Debit Cards Settings not found for Employer

get.description: Retrieve the associated health savings accounts for a given consumer

parameters.name: person_id
parameters.description: The GUID generated by the Identity Management Service for accessing this specific person and it's related resources.

parameters.name: X-Request-Id
parameters.description: Optional correlation ID associated with the request.

404.description: Not Found.  No Consumer found for supplied ID.

get.summary: Get Health Savings Account Custodian for a given consumer, if they have an active HSA account.
get.description: Retrieve the associated health savings account's custodian for a given consumer.  The custodian's settings returned is currently ONLY a small subset of the full scope of settings.

parameters.name: person_id
parameters.description: The GUID generated by the Identity Management Service for accessing this specific person and it's related resources.

parameters.name: X-Request-Id
parameters.description: Optional correlation ID associated with the request.

404.description: Not Found.  No Consumer or Custodian found for supplied ID.

get.description: Checks if the provided routing number is valid.

parameters.name: routing_number
parameters.description: The bank routing number to validate.

parameters.name: X-Request-Id
parameters.description: Optional correlation ID associated with the request.

get.summary: Get a consumer's bank account information.
get.description: Retrieve the associated bank accounts for a consumer based on the personId.

parameters.name: person_id
parameters.description: The unique identifier for the request.

parameters.name: account_use
parameters.description:
An optional parameter that filters the bank accounts by their use. Options are: Unspecified,
DirectDeposit, ReimbursementDebitCard, VebaWithdrawals, Other.

parameters.name: include_address
parameters.description:
An optional parameter that includes bank account addresses in the response. Default is
false.

parameters.name: X-Request-Id
parameters.description: Optional correlation ID associated with the request.

200.description: The request was successful, and a list of bank accounts (which may be empty) is returned.

404.description: The person with the specified personId was not found.

post.summary: Apply (create or update) a consumer bank account
post.description:
Creates a new bank account or updates an existing one for the specified consumer.
If accountId is null in the request body, a new account will be created.
If accountId is provided, the existing account will be updated.

parameters.name: X-Request-Id
parameters.description: Optional correlation ID associated with the request.
